description: This file defines the ContentTypeDefinitionBuilder class used for constructing ContentTypeDefinition objects with methods for setting properties, merging settings, and managing parts within the OrchardCore content management system.

classes.name: ContentTypeDefinitionBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ContentTypeDefinition objects, allowing configuration of name, display name, settings, and parts.

classes.name: ContentTypePartDefinitionBuilder
classes.description: A nested builder class used internally for configuring content type parts within ContentTypeDefinitionBuilder.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs a ContentTypeDefinition object after validating the name.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the name of the content type.

methods.name: WithDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the content type.

methods.name: MergeSettings
methods.description: Merges provided JSON settings into the builder's settings.

methods.name: MergeSettings<T>
methods.description: Merges specific settings of type T into the builder's settings.

methods.name: WithSettings
methods.description: Sets the entire settings object for the content type.

methods.name: RemovePart
methods.description: Removes a part by type or name from the content type.

methods.name: WithPart
methods.description: Adds or configures a part for the content type, with multiple overloads for different configurations.

methods.name: WithPartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or configures a part.
